title: potentilla heterophylla subsp. amphibola
intro: Potentilla heterophylla subsp. amphibola, commonly known as Marsh Cinquefoil, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to the northwestern regions of North America. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Cinquefoil include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
